findings: Learner overview and takeaway present a hypothetical borrowing of 方 for “square” as the main explanation, but formation explicitly says the depicted object's name and sound match are unknown. That preserves uncertainty, yet the overview does not first state the supported whole-graph construction and current meanings as a clear first-reading layer. Lead with 方 as a single graph with disputed pictorial referent and its common meanings; keep the possible sound-based borrowing and its unknown match in the takeaway or detailed account.
